canonicalFacts.claim: SUDEP risk in children with epilepsy (aged 0-17 years) is 0.22/1,000 patient-years
Cannabidiol significantly reduces drop seizures in Lennox-Gastaut syndrome when added to conventional antiepileptic medications
Approximately 30% of patients with epilepsy have treatment-resistant forms associated with severe morbidity and increased mortality
Two-thirds of patients with epilepsy are controlled with established antiseizure medications
Stiripentol, fenfluramine, and cannabidiol are licensed add-on therapies for treating seizures in Dravet syndrome

redFlags: Felbamate was associated with aplastic anemia and hepatic failure leading to restricted use
Ezogabine (retigabine) was withdrawn from market in 2017 due to retinal and skin pigmentation changes
